_comment: THE REFUSAL INVENTORY. Phase 2 of plans/greenfield-harness-rewrite.md.
Each entry is an INVARIANT the new harness must preserve, not a line of code. They were
collapsed from 240 refusal-shaped sites on the live path (sweep.py 100, encode_run.py 72,
codec_verdict.py 6, analyze.py 5, safe_rm.py 5) via the 77 blocks the repo marks with its
strongest warning. Many sites enforce one invariant -- `ssh_host` alone was four.
EVERY ONE EXISTS BECAUSE SOMETHING SILENTLY PRODUCED A WRONG ANSWER ONCE. That is the
selection rule: ordinary validation (file missing, bad argument) is NOT here, because a new
harness grows it naturally. These do not grow naturally -- they were paid for.
`today` cites where the invariant lives in the tree being archived, so the reasoning can be
read before it goes. `test` is the assertion the NEW harness must carry. An entry with no
test in the new suite is an invariant that has been dropped, whether or not anyone meant to.
`disposition` says what the NEW harness does about it: by_construction -- a mechanised pipeline
with typed inputs has no path that could violate it; check -- a store invariant, an x_* view or a
script check that must return zero rows; process -- a rule a stage applies that the store cannot
verify; judgement -- a person's call. `how` names the table, column, view or stage.

identity_and_provenance.invariant: Host identity must not fall back to another card's tool on a multi-card box.
identity_and_provenance.prevents: nvidia-smi succeeds on a VAAPI run and wins by being first, so a B580 record was stamped `NVIDIA RTX A4000`. It parsed, had the right schema, plausible noise floors and the correct node stamp. Found by eye, which is the wrong way to catch it.
identity_and_provenance.test: A record produced under a profile whose backends exclude nvenc never names an NVIDIA device.
identity_and_provenance.how: the unit is a row the run names (`run.encoder_unit_id`), never a tool's guess; `x_run_unit_not_on_host` keeps it in its box

identity_and_provenance.invariant: Address the card by PCI slot and resolve symlinks. Never a render-node number.
identity_and_provenance.prevents: renderD128/129 inverted twice, once across a reboot; `--device` resolves to a major:minor at CREATE time and reuses it, which put production on the wrong card.
identity_and_provenance.test: Device selection resolves through by-path and yields the expected vendor id.
identity_and_provenance.how: `host_unit.device` is the only device address; the DDL refuses a render-node number

identity_and_provenance.invariant: A behaviour record written for another node, or carrying a unit outside the profile's silicon, is REFUSED.
identity_and_provenance.prevents: A stale dump from another card parses fine and reads as this one's.
identity_and_provenance.test: A record whose node or unit set does not match the requested profile is refused, not merged.
identity_and_provenance.how: a verdict row carries its unit by foreign key; there is no file to mis-attribute

identity_and_provenance.invariant: The metric backend is part of the scorer's version string and therefore of the cell key.
identity_and_provenance.prevents: Two cells scored on different metric backends comparing as though they were the same measurement.
identity_and_provenance.test: Changing the metric backend changes the cell key.
identity_and_provenance.how: `scorer.metric_backend` is part of the build strings `add-scorer` takes from the agent's `identify`, and `score`'s primary key carries `scorer_build`; K1 deliberately excludes it, so a re-score under another scorer is a new row, not a collision

identity_and_provenance.invariant: Host/backend scoping must reach EVERY command builder, and the set is discovered by introspection, not listed by hand.
identity_and_provenance.prevents: A one-site fix to an N-site defect, twice in one week (`ssh_host`, then `--backends`). A hand-written list says what the author remembered, not what exists.
identity_and_provenance.test: Every builder is enumerated by introspection and asserted scoped; a builder that must not be has to declare itself exempt with a reason.
identity_and_provenance.how: one command builder reads `host` and `host_unit`; there is no list of builders

identity_and_provenance.invariant: A shipped value carries `measured` for a lane only if that lane's population is REPRESENTED in its evidence class -- at least one member's title satisfies the lane's predicates -- and the row says how many; otherwise it is `derived`, whatever the row says.
identity_and_provenance.prevents: kids-ipad-standard-sdr ships -cq 28 marked measured. Its evidence windows -- soul, walle, interstellar, joker -- are all 4K HDR remuxes, tonemapped through the chain; SDR television, the lane's population, never appeared in the sample. The lane is meant for ANY content, so the fix is sampling, not relabeling -- but the marker must say which.
today: all-gpu-encoder-sweep/windows.json (hdr true on every standard window)
identity_and_provenance.test: provenance = measured is computed by a join over title, content_class_member and the lane's predicates, never written by hand; a lane with zero covering members cannot be marked measured, and a hand-written measured that the join contradicts fails the build-order generator.

identity_and_provenance.invariant: A constant of the bitrate logic carries the provenance of its value: measured has no typed value and comes from a calibrate run; policy is typed, with the reason and the bound that justify it; derived is typed, with its inputs and its precision.
identity_and_provenance.prevents: MARGIN shipped as `measured` with nothing behind the word but a section number, while RESULTS 19.8 itself calls it a policy choice bounded by the probe's precision. The first draft of Stage 10b then defined MARGIN as the rate-request headroom -- a different quantity, the unnamed 0.98 factor that overshoots on 15 of 15 -- and would have calibrated the wrong constant from the right instrument.
identity_and_provenance.test: constant.provenance is one of measured, derived, policy; a measured constant with a typed value is refused, a policy one without a reason is refused, a derived one without inputs and precision is refused; a measured constant with no constant_value row is refused.

admissibility.invariant: Read STDERR, never the exit status.
admissibility.prevents: A device with no decoder for the codec makes ffmpeg fall back to software and EXIT 0. The VC-1 case returned rc=0 on a card that cannot decode it.
admissibility.test: A decode probe on an unsupported codec is reported unsupported despite rc=0.
admissibility.how: `cell_failure.stderr` is NOT NULL; `rc` is recorded and never trusted

admissibility.invariant: A probe that did not run is not evidence of support. No failure signature AND a non-zero rc must RAISE.
admissibility.prevents: A verification harness reported the 9070 XT as decoding VC-1 -- a card measured minutes earlier as unable to -- because the invocation never ran and stderr came back empty. A probe that did not run returning a POSITIVE is worse than one that errors: nothing looks wrong.
admissibility.test: An invocation that fails to launch raises rather than returning a capability verdict.
admissibility.how: `x_verdict_without_cells`: a verdict must name the encodes behind it

admissibility.invariant: A leg or stage is verified by FRAME COUNT, never by exit status.
admissibility.prevents: A null-terminated leg processes zero frames and exits 0; VAAPI hardware frames into the null muxer print 'Nothing was written into output file' and exit 0. It killed the decode leg of all 14 cells on the first run.
admissibility.test: A leg that produced zero frames is a failure even at rc=0.

admissibility.invariant: A capability verdict is scoped to (vendor, codec). A measurement on one card must never be enforced on another.
admissibility.prevents: `-rc_mode ICQ` was refused on ALL vaapi from a 9070 XT measurement, on a card where ICQ opens fine. The screen escaped it only by accident -- a LADDER carrying the flag would have been refused.
admissibility.test: A guard measured on one vendor does not fire on another; an unidentifiable card fails CLOSED.

admissibility.invariant: The effective rate-control mode is DERIVED per frontend, not read off the command line.
admissibility.prevents: QSV does not put the mode in argv -- it is implied by which quality flag is set (`-q:v` CQP, `-global_quality` alone ICQ, `-b:v`+`-maxrate` CBR, `-b:v` alone VBR). The guard read argv, could not fire, and 126 QVBR cells failed for it.
admissibility.test: The mode is resolved from the option set per frontend, and a guarded mode is caught on every frontend the vendor declares.

admissibility.invariant: An unrecognised backend, codec or encoder REFUSES. It never falls back to a default.
admissibility.prevents: `quality_range` returned (0,51) for anything unrecognised, so a new backend inherited hevc_nvenc's bounds and out-of-range values read as IN range -- the shape that made a PARTIAL verdict an artefact. `Cell.encoder()` read 'nvenc if backend==nvenc else vaapi', so every qsv cell would have emitted av1_vaapi commands and filed the results under QSV.
admissibility.test: An unknown backend raises at plan time rather than naming a real encoder or a default range.
admissibility.how: enum CHECKs on frontend and codec; foreign keys everywhere a name is used

admissibility.invariant: A screen prerequisite must be one the card is MEASURED to honour, and the verdict records the base it was taken under. A base that cannot open the encoder gives BASE_FAILED, never REJECTED.
admissibility.prevents: A single-flag screen cannot see an option whose precondition is unmet -- it reads INERT, indistinguishable from a card that ignores it. A plausible-but-unverified base manufactures a SECOND artefact wearing the appearance of a met precondition.
admissibility.test: A base that fails alone yields BASE_FAILED; every verdict carries its base.

admissibility.invariant: A block that is wholly inadmissible is EXCLUDED with a written reason, not screened and recorded INERT.
admissibility.prevents: An omission reading as an oversight rather than a decision.
admissibility.test: Exclusions are enumerated with reasons and appear in the record.
admissibility.how: `setting_verdict.reason` is required when the verdict is EXCLUDED

admissibility.invariant: Monotonicity is tested at STEP 1 on the BINDING window, with repeats.
admissibility.prevents: A step-4 sweep on an easy window reported 'monotone' and walked straight over a reversal. A curve that doubles back cannot be inverted.
admissibility.test: The monotonicity check refuses a step size larger than 1 and a window that is not the binding one.
admissibility.how: Stage 1's third admissibility test; the store holds the verdict, not the sweep

admissibility.invariant: A target outside the encoder's quality range is UNREACHABLE -- an admissibility property, not a missing measurement.
admissibility.prevents: Spending cells trying to reach a target the encoder structurally cannot produce. `av1_qsv` ends at cq 51.
admissibility.test: A ladder rung outside the encoder's range is refused at plan time, and the table cell reads UNREACHABLE.
admissibility.how: `setting.range_hi`; Stage 10 reports UNREACHABLE rather than a number

measurement_validity.invariant: A delta smaller than the measured spread is not a result, and the spread is measured per run, not assumed.
measurement_validity.prevents: Differencing two legs compounds their noise; an encoder cost lost inside a 29 s software decode read as '100.6% decode / -0.2% encode'.
measurement_validity.test: Each stage carries a within-noise flag, and raw values are NOT clamped to look sensible.
measurement_validity.how: `timing.noise_floor_pct` is on the row; Stage 9 reads against it

measurement_validity.invariant: A software-decoded throughput number is never averaged into a hardware one, and the path is labelled on the row.
measurement_validity.prevents: ~4.6x on identical content, ~11x for VC-1. One N* cannot describe both a CPU-bound and a GPU-bound window.
measurement_validity.test: A row records its decode path; a batch reports software if ANY worker fell back.
measurement_validity.how: `timing.decode_path` NOT NULL; the content-rate check partitions on it

measurement_validity.invariant: Ablation legs are the production argv TRUNCATED, never rebuilt.
measurement_validity.prevents: A rebuilt ladder is how an ablation and the chain it explains drift apart. Leg 3 must BE the production command.
measurement_validity.test: Every leg is a literal prefix of the production argv.

measurement_validity.invariant: 'Not given' and 'explicitly serial' must not collapse into one value.
measurement_validity.prevents: A thread count of 0 means serial and None means derive-a-default; collapsing them silently changes the measurement.
measurement_validity.how: STRICT types and NOT NULL; there is no CSV blank to misread

measurement_validity.invariant: Refuse at launch when the named build lacks the requested metric filter, rather than falling back.
measurement_validity.prevents: Silently scoring on a different backend from the one the run declares.
measurement_validity.test: A build without the filter refuses before any cell runs.
measurement_validity.how: the launch primitive; `run.metric_backend` records what ran

measurement_validity.invariant: The score height defaults to the panel derived per source, never the native control.
measurement_validity.prevents: A 120-cell grid that closed a codec decision ended up with NO panel score at all. Earlier, all 167 cells of a lane were scored at the wrong resolution -- a 13.04-point, content-dependent error that cannot be offset back.
measurement_validity.test: An empty height list resolves to the panel; the panel's absence from an explicit list warns loudly.

measurement_validity.invariant: The first timing sample is discarded, and the discard is recorded on the row.
measurement_validity.prevents: A cold first run produced a fake 4.7% speed-up.
measurement_validity.test: The reported statistic excludes sample 0 and the row says so.
measurement_validity.how: `timing.is_warmup` is recorded; the content-rate check filters it

measurement_validity.invariant: framemd5 for pixels; byte count for size. Never sha256.
measurement_validity.prevents: `av1_vaapi` and `hevc_nvenc` both produce different sha256 at identical byte counts from the same command. A driver comparison was nearly reported from pure run-to-run noise; only a repeated control caught it.
measurement_validity.how: `cut.content_sha` is a frame hash by definition; nothing compares encodes by sha

measurement_validity.invariant: A stage is gated on CONTENT as well as integrity.
measurement_validity.prevents: A staged cut carried no Dolby Vision RPU while its source carried profile 8, and every checksum on every node was correct -- they were faithful copies of a broken cut.
measurement_validity.test: A cut missing an expected indicator fails even when its sha matches.

measurement_validity.invariant: Screens run on real content of the class -- one window can find HONOURED, INERT needs every member -- and a screen magnitude is never carried into a lane conclusion.
measurement_validity.prevents: A published `-compression_level` verdict of 10.33% was 0.27-0.61% on real cuts. The screen also runs at the ladder midpoint, which can be far outside the lane's operating range -- three different figures for one flag were all correct at their own operating points. And an INERT taken on one clip excluded a setting from the search with n = 1; the lane doc records the content caveat and nothing enforced it.
measurement_validity.test: Every encode input names a title -- no synthetic row type exists; setting_verdict is per window; the unit-level INERT is derived only when every member of the class is inert; the record carries the operating point the verdict was taken at.
measurement_validity.how: every input names a title; `v_setting_unit_reading` needs the class before INERT

the_artifact_must_come_home.invariant: Every field that is part of the cell key must appear in every CSV the campaign reads.
the_artifact_must_come_home.prevents: A settings search's candidates differ ONLY in `extra`. The timing CSV omitted it, so 40 rows resolved to the INADMISSIBLE arm; it surfaced as an honest 'SPEED UNMEASURED' only because the baseline also had no rows. Had the baseline matched by chance it would have printed WRONG deltas silently. The same defect had already been recorded for the scored CSV.
the_artifact_must_come_home.test: Every key field is asserted present in every emitted table.
the_artifact_must_come_home.how: settings are `cell_setting` rows; there is no CSV column to lose

the_artifact_must_come_home.invariant: Each mode DECLARES the artifact it produces, and the waiter fetches whatever was declared. A failed fetch is FATAL.
the_artifact_must_come_home.prevents: Fetching was an if/elif on flags: `--split` fetched, `--time` did not, so a completed 45-row timing run was invisible to the only tool that reads it. Fired twice -- 2026-08-30 (`scored=35/35 fetched=0/1`) and 2026-09-04. A failed scp still only PRINTS today.
the_artifact_must_come_home.test: A mode that produces a file cannot complete without fetching it; a failed fetch exits non-zero.

the_artifact_must_come_home.invariant: A whole-file producer's previous output is MOVED aside before launch. Renamed, never deleted.
the_artifact_must_come_home.prevents: The waiter fired 2 s in on the previous run's CSV -- 'complete: 14/14 in 0s' while the real job was still running -- and the fetch brought home the old file. Fired again on `--mode encode`, which was unguarded, leaving a live node script running at 29/42.
the_artifact_must_come_home.test: A pre-existing output is renamed before launch; a resuming producer is exempt with a reason.
the_artifact_must_come_home.how: products are rows under a new `run_id`; there is no whole-file producer

the_artifact_must_come_home.invariant: Wait on the ledger/row count, never the log, and probe liveness so a dead job does not read as a slow one.
the_artifact_must_come_home.prevents: A child's stdout does not reliably reach its log: a 30-cell encode wrote its CSV correctly while the log jumped straight from ALL VERIFIED to the done marker.
the_artifact_must_come_home.test: Completion is decided by the artifact; an IDLE node short of the expected count is reported GONE.
the_artifact_must_come_home.how: the waiter reads `v_run_progress` and `run_event`; the plan is the cells

the_artifact_must_come_home.invariant: Scoring copies its inputs, and the copy is removed ONLY on a verified clean finish -- through safe_rm, never a bare rm on a node.
the_artifact_must_come_home.prevents: `--mode score` unlinks what it consumes, so the originals must survive a failure. But nothing removed the staging when a run died and nothing noticed afterwards: the orphan check compares work/toscore against the ledgers and does not look at score/ at all. The operator named it -- 'this is why there is so much garbage in the sweep dir'.
the_artifact_must_come_home.test: A failed run leaves its staging; a clean one removes it; removal goes through the guarded deleter.

the_artifact_must_come_home.invariant: A leftover staging directory is checked BEFORE anything is copied into it.
the_artifact_must_come_home.prevents: Otherwise the copy fills the gaps and an orphan becomes indistinguishable from a fresh copy.
the_artifact_must_come_home.test: A pre-populated staging directory is refused before the copy step.
the_artifact_must_come_home.how: no staging directory exists in the model; a cell is addressed by its key

the_artifact_must_come_home.invariant: Drive from the ledger's own recorded paths. Never glob a shared directory.
the_artifact_must_come_home.prevents: `work/toscore` accumulates across runs -- 66 files while the run was 30, and eta held 446 while a run was 120. A preflight that counted by globbing reported agreement that did not exist.
the_artifact_must_come_home.test: Counting and copying iterate ledger records and name the missing cells.
the_artifact_must_come_home.how: everything is driven from cell keys

the_artifact_must_come_home.invariant: An arriving table is filed by its HEADER fingerprint; the operator never chooses the directory. An existing identical copy succeeds; a DIFFERENT one refuses and keeps both.
the_artifact_must_come_home.prevents: Misfiling enters where a human picks a path. Overwriting a committed result with a re-scored one silently rewrites the evidence a published finding cites.
the_artifact_must_come_home.test: A differing file at the destination refuses and parks the new one.
the_artifact_must_come_home.how: no table arrives as a file; rows go to the store

orchestration.invariant: Node-touching modes refuse to run outside the orchestrator.
orchestration.prevents: Hand-typed invocations, which is the defect the committed descriptors exist to remove.
orchestration.test: A node-touching mode invoked directly refuses; read-only modes are exempt.
orchestration.how: node-touching stages are the harness's verbs; there is no other entry

orchestration.invariant: Binaries and devices come from the host profile. A descriptor that declares them is REFUSED.
orchestration.prevents: media-01 holds two cards and the render-node numbering has inverted twice, so hand-typing the device is how a probe answers about the wrong one.
orchestration.test: A descriptor setting a host-wiring key is refused.
orchestration.how: `host` and `host_unit` rows; a run references them by key

orchestration.invariant: Every run and every probe is driven by a committed descriptor, and the expected count is DERIVED, never typed.
orchestration.prevents: Four probes produced results cited in RESULTS and not one could be reproduced from the repo; 98 scripts had to be collected off three machines to recover what actually ran. A hand-typed count is the defect this repo keeps re-finding.
orchestration.test: The expected count comes from a plan invocation on the node; a descriptor carrying one is refused.
orchestration.how: the run and its planned cells ARE the invocation; the count is `count(cell)`

orchestration.invariant: Detach with setsid and full redirection, and arm the waiter in the SAME action as the launch.
orchestration.prevents: `nohup ... & disown` keeps the ssh channel open until the remote job FINISHES -- measured, a 20 s script returned in 21.2 s. The supervisor died on an ssh timeout three times while the remote job ran on. Separately, three runs finished unobserved because the launch returned immediately and nothing watched them.
orchestration.test: The launch returns before the job ends, and the waiter is armed by the same call.
orchestration.how: the launch primitive writes the `launched` event in the same action

orchestration.invariant: Refuse to push or launch onto a node already running the harness.
orchestration.prevents: A client-side ssh timeout does not stop a remote job, so a missing stamp is not evidence that nothing is running. Re-launching pushes new code underneath a live run.
orchestration.test: A busy node refuses both the push and the launch; re-attach is a separate verb that launches nothing.

orchestration.invariant: After every push, prove arrival by sha on BOTH ends and refuse if they still differ.
orchestration.prevents: Node copies drifted five times, twice silently -- once producing a valid-looking grid that measured the wrong thing, once scoring 144 rows at the wrong height.
orchestration.test: A short or altered copy exits non-zero having asserted nothing.
orchestration.how: the deploy step; the sha on both ends goes into `run_event.detail`

orchestration.invariant: An unusable host refuses at the moment of use, with the fix in the message.
orchestration.prevents: It was already written down in a plan that the container was slated for deletion, and that document was not read before a run was attempted. Prose in a file nobody opens is not a safeguard.
orchestration.test: A blocked profile refuses and the message carries the remedy.

orchestration.invariant: Status is read-only and never fails on an unreachable node. UNKNOWN is a different symbol from ZERO.
orchestration.prevents: A status command that dies when a machine is off is useless exactly when it is needed. A returncode that was returned rather than raised made a live node read as `pushed=0/2` -- 'go push' about a node that was current.
orchestration.test: An unreachable stage reads unknown; no failure path collapses to zero.
orchestration.how: status is `v_run_progress`, read from the store

the_search.invariant: A ladder is per (candidate, window), not per candidate.
the_search.prevents: The rungs one window needs are not the rungs another needs; a shared ladder puts arms at different bitrates and leaves windows below the BD-rate floor.
the_search.test: Derived ladders are keyed by both.

the_search.invariant: The common bitrate range is set by ADMISSIBLE arms only.
the_search.prevents: An arm that is not on the curve must not decide the range the curves are compared over.
the_search.test: An excluded arm's ladder does not move the shared range.
the_search.how: an arm with an unhonoured setting cannot exist: `x_arm_setting_not_honoured`

the_search.invariant: Bound how far a derived rung may sit from a measured one, and never extrapolate.
the_search.prevents: The clamp bites systematically rather than occasionally; a rung derived far from any measurement is a guess wearing a number.
the_search.test: A rung outside the measured span is refused, not clamped silently.
the_search.how: Stage 10's straddling pair; UNREACHABLE outside it

the_search.invariant: Refuse a locate ladder whose arms' bitrate spans do not intersect -- 'widen the locate sweep'.
the_search.prevents: BD-rate integrates over a shared range; without one the ranking is meaningless.
the_search.test: Non-intersecting spans refuse with the remedy.

the_search.invariant: Speed aggregates within a MEASURED decode path. A window on another path is reported beside the hardware ones, never averaged in and never excluded. There is no authored window-exclusion list.
the_search.prevents: Two tests proved the CODE honoured an exclusion while the committed spec never set the key -- it held only because the timing config happened to omit the window. SUPERSEDED 2026-09-05: the first fix was to declare the exclusion in the spec, which restates a measurement (the decode path) as authorship. DATA-MODEL.md, THE SAMPLE, rule 3.
the_search.test: Every timing row carries decode_path from the decode probe; the speed verdict is computed per path and names it; a spec key that excludes a window from a criterion is refused by the loader; the window stays in the efficiency set on every path.
the_search.how: `timing.decode_path`; there is no exclusion list to author

the_search.invariant: A missing axis is reported UNMEASURED, never treated as unchanged.
the_search.prevents: A categorisation silently computed over a speed axis nobody measured.
the_search.test: Categorisation without a timing table says the speed axis is unmeasured.
the_search.how: the content-rate check reports UNMEASURED; Stage 9 does the same

the_search.invariant: An inadmissible arm is EXCLUDED from the ranking, never placed last in it.
the_search.prevents: A BD-rate over an inadmissible configuration is a number with no meaning.
the_search.test: An excluded arm appears with an exclusion reason and no rank.
the_search.how: an inadmissible arm cannot enter the search

the_search.invariant: Aggregate per window first, then take a MEDIAN. Never a mean over windows.
the_search.prevents: A mean-over-windows comparison reversed a `-tune` verdict because two high-bitrate windows dominated it; per window the sign flipped.
the_search.test: The reported statistic is a median and the range is carried with it.
the_search.how: Stage 8's aggregation, named in its output; analysis writes nothing

the_search.invariant: Refuse rows carrying more than one score height, and record the height beside the metric.
the_search.prevents: SSIMULACRA2 is scale-sensitive by up to 23 points; a number without its height is not usable in the deliverable.
the_search.test: A mixed-height table is refused; a single-height one is labelled.

the_search.invariant: Rungs a ranking never saw go in their own ledger.
the_search.prevents: Extension rungs silently entering a ranked ladder and changing a verdict.
the_search.test: A ladder extension writes to a distinct ledger.
the_search.how: extension rungs are the base arm's codec-ladder rows, distinct from the arm ladders

the_search.invariant: A run declares ONE content class and covers all of it. Coverage smaller than the class is labelled k of n and is not the class's verdict; coverage outside the class is refused.
the_search.prevents: The B580 lane's locate ran on 7 windows, the search on 6, timing on 5, and the -b_strategy 1 arms were ranked on 4 -- with the reasons in a spec comment, a docstring and the ranking code, and the verdict's n written nowhere.
the_search.test: run_window records what ran; rank reports k of n per verdict and refuses to label a partial coverage as the class's; a cell whose window is not a member of the run's class is refused at plan time.

the_search.invariant: An incumbent arm is pinned at the anchor it ships and has a scored cell at that anchor on every member of the class, at the search's height, so the bar the incumbent rule reads was measured on this class and this unit. The cell may be the base arm's.
the_search.prevents: The incumbent rule read 'the incumbent arm's score at the panel' while Stage 5 encoded only the base arm and the candidates; the three incumbent checks proved the arm existed and was viewed, never that it had a cell. Found on the 2026-09-06 cold read, not by an incident.
the_search.test: for every incumbent arm, every class member has a reference-cut cell whose identity settings equal the arm's plus its pinned anchor, with a score row at the search's height.
the_search.how: `incumbent_arm_scored` (script); `arm.anchor_value` is required by the DDL for role = incumbent
